about_the_game:
DOORKA is a fast-paced first-person shooter without guns, but with doors instead, based on the unique ULTRAKILL gameplay with an even more unique door-kicking mechanic.

You are an ordinary worker from the Kirov door factory named Artem, who just wants to drink beer. But the factory is invaded by robot vacuum cleaners, tired of the oppression of doors, they intend to stop the production of doors and clean the factory of people. You have to break through the crowds of enraged robot vacuum cleaners and have a hearty cold beer.

  • Use your only, but universal tool, a kick, to move and stay mobile under the merciless onslaught of robot vacuum cleaners.

  • Kick doors in the air, on the ground or in doorways with style to destroy evil robots.

  • Knocking down doors heals and keeps your leg in good shape.

  • Your iron head can take quite a lot of beatings, but factory life hasn't killed your sense of pain yet, so be careful.

  • Your leg isn't really useful against vacuum cleaners, but it can send doors in air at high speed into your enemies, which is the only weakness of robot vacuum cleaners.

content_descriptors.notes: The game may contain references to alcohol, tobacco, drugs and offensive language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 with 2 Ghz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
